title: GenSpan: Generation-Calibrated Motion Span Priors for Multi-Verb Video Corpus Moment Retrieval

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: To address this, GenSpan uses a generated-prior-guided token selector that keeps a measured fraction of candidate-video tokens most aligned with the auxiliary motion prior.

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: GenSpan: Generation-Calibrated Motion Span Priors for Multi-Verb Video Corpus Moment Retrieval Text-driven video moment retrieval (VMR) remains challenging due to limited capture of hidden temporal dynamics in untrimmed videos, leading to imprecise grounding in long sequences.

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: GenSpan: Generation-Calibrated Motion Span Priors for Multi-Verb Video Corpus Moment Retrieval Text-driven video moment retrieval (VMR) remains challenging due to limited capture of hidden temporal dynamics in untrimmed videos, leading to imprecise grounding in long sequences.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: Traditional methods rely on natural language queries (NLQs) or static image augmentations, overlooking motion sequences and suffering from high computational costs in Transformer-based architectures.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: Existing approaches fail to integrate subtitle contexts and generated temporal priors effectively, we therefore propose a novel two-stage framework for enhanced temporal grounding.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: In the first stage, LLM-guided subtitle matching identifies relevant textual cues from video subtitles, fused with the query to generate auxiliary short videos via text-to-video models, capturing implicit motion information as temporal priors.

methods.name: Multi-Modal Fusion and Feature Enhancement
methods.evidence_sentence: In the second stage, augmented queries are processed through a multi-modal controlled Mamba network, extending text-controlled selection with video-guided gating for efficient fusion of generated priors and long sequences while filtering noise.
